entities.summary: Peng Shaohui was a general in the People's Liberation Army (PLA) of China. He was the only original PLA General to be born in the same county as Mao Zedong. He was known as "One-Armed General" after a wounded arm was amputated during the Chinese Civil War. Peng served twice as deputy commander of the PLA and was a member of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party three times.
